current_binary_error_differential.scope: Five identical original-DOS startup invocations: success, parser failure, missing target, duplicate link, recovery; primary returns, fault inputs and format strings, link decisions, candidate ownership, unchanged shared image and exact alias readbacks. final_secondary_evidence.scope: Five current-HUNK versus original Workbench MakeLink calls through the same original DOS. Final owning-process pr_Result2 at public RunCommand return is compared after cleanup. Other options, handlers, startup, cleanup-error injections, rendered output and full-profile/purity/shipping remain separate.

rendered_output_evidence.scope: Five original-Kickstart-DOS invocations with separate redirected RAM files, independently sized and read after resident removal; exact diagnostic bytes including two empty success outputs, completed RunCommand primary returns and Process.Result2, target/link decisions, balanced candidate resources and alias content. Current 68000 HUNK only; no full profile, startup or pure/resident admission.

option_matrix_evidence.scope: Nine original-DOS ReadArgs scenarios for positional/reordered/equals syntax, quoted spaces/escaped quote, HARD/FORCE on a regular file, repeated switch and rejected duplicate/unknown/missing arguments. Six hard-link calls succeed and five aliases have independent post-removal readback. No interactive help/EOF, Latin-1, empty names, all path forms or complete option/profile admission.

scope.Sampling: Post-instruction-retirement CPU state, first HUNK entry through its matching user-mode return; same-task callees included.
scope.BoundsAuthority: Published tc_SPLower/tc_SPUpper captured at HUNK entry and checked at each owner user-mode sample; RunCommand D2 is recorded, never converted into guessed bounds.
scope.Exclusions: RunCommand prelude/postlude, other tasks, supervisor/interrupt stacks, and samples outside or with changed entry task bounds are counted separately.
scope.Limits: Observed SP low-water marks are not a stack-write/canary proof, allocation ownership proof, universal minimum stack, or coverage of unsampled host gateway work and intra-instruction transients. Bounds mismatches remain explicit unknowns, not passing safety evidence.

help_eof_evidence.scope: Two original-Kickstart-DOS invocations of the known '?' ReadArgs help trigger with real Shell redirected input/output: complete continuation arguments create a hard link; an independently verified empty input produces EOF. Exact independently read output bytes, final RunCommand primary and Process.Result2, parser/mutation decisions, candidate ownership and four input/content readbacks after resident removal. Fixed 68000 HUNK; no interactive console, break handling, full profile or PURE admission.

native_copperstart_dos_evidence.scope: Native candidate, installed production DOS RunCommand/ReadArgs/mutation/formatting/provider bridge; Exec and bounded backing packet handler are fixtures. No full-system, filesystem, pure/resident or shipping approval.
